MyFonts lets you return a font within 7 days (by confirming its deletion) for a refund, or swap a wrongly purchased font within 14 days.

blocks.title: Legal & Practical Info
blocks.lead: Massachusetts law by default, under Monotype’s Terms and Conditions of Business. Desktop rights transfer only as a complete handover.

rows.t: Founded in 2010 by Timo Gaessner and Alexander Colby, later managed by Maiko Gubler. Before the acquisition the company was Milieu Grotesque, LDA in Santo Isidoro, Portugal; the catalogue is now owned by Monotype Imaging Inc.
All rights may be transferred to another person or entity if they accept the agreement, all copies are destroyed and the scope of use does not change. Renting, lending or sublicensing is prohibited.

The EULAs defer to Monotype’s Terms and Conditions of Business: Massachusetts law, with courts in Massachusetts. If contracted through Monotype Ltd. or Monotype GmbH, English law (London) or German law (Frankfurt/Main) applies instead.
Monotype may request proof of compliance, to be provided within 30 days; usage beyond the licensed amounts must be licensed and paid for.

blocks.title: Pricing Model
blocks.lead: Desktop is counted by users, web by monthly page impressions, apps and devices by lifetime distribution units — prices are shown upfront online.

rows.t: Install & Use is priced per user; each user’s licence covers up to five devices. Host & Link is priced by maximum page impressions per month, Embed & Distribute by total lifetime distribution units. Licences start at $42 for one user and a single weight of a single-edition family.
rows.sub: Tiers on the Aktiv Grotesk page, for example: 1 to 3,500 users; 50k to 35M page impressions per month; 2k to 1.4M distribution units.

rows.t: The EULA doesn’t say whether client or agency should hold the licence. It binds “you” as licensee, and its definition of User includes your employees, contractors and other authorized agents — so contractors working for the licence holder are counted as users.
Standard licences are perpetual: pay once, use forever, and upgrade users or page impressions at any time. Renewable licences are available on request.
rows.sub: Consumers may cancel within 14 days of purchase, provided the fonts haven’t been downloaded.

blocks.title: License Types
blocks.lead: Three core licences — Install & Use, Host & Link and Embed & Distribute — plus Server and Unlimited options, bought separately with no forced bundling.

rows.t: Desktop fonts on up to five devices per licensed user. Output may be used for print, publication, broadcast, streaming, social media and public exhibition. Non-editable PDFs may embed the fonts, but not commercial digital documents such as ebooks.

Self-hosted WOFF/WOFF2 via @font-face on any number of your own websites, on your own servers or a CDN, and in digital ads you control. You must measure page impressions with a recognized analytics platform at your own cost and block third-party referencing.
App fonts embedded in apps, games, ebooks and hardware devices, counted as the cumulative total of devices supplied plus downloads or copies distributed. Personalized documents are excluded.

A Server licence covers automated document generation, including personalized documents. Unlimited Perpetual bundles all licence types without limits, plus server installation and Software Bundle Distribution; the online shop switches to it automatically when it’s cheaper.

A subscription to the whole library for organizations: FontPass Flex from $4,000 per month per licence type, or All-Access at $24,000 per month. Minimum term 12 months, up to five years; no record-keeping or reporting.

blocks.title: Additional Costs & Special Cases
blocks.lead: Logo use is covered by Install & Use — the fonts themselves may only be changed by Dalton Maag.

rows.t: Under Install & Use you may modify the output in artwork and register artwork containing it as a trademark — no separate logo licence.

You may not adapt, modify, convert or create derivative works of the font software. Automated subsetting and format conversion are allowed solely for hosting or embedding. Changes are offered as a paid Font Modification service.
The fonts or their output may not be used to train generative AI models where the intent or result is replicating the style, weight or structure of the typeface design.
Companies and organizations must, on request, document and certify within 30 days that all use conforms to their Licence Pack and the agreement.

blocks.title: Discounts & Trials
blocks.lead: Free, fully featured trial fonts for the whole library — no student discount is mentioned.

rows.t: A free trial licence for all library fonts, static and variable, with all weights, styles and axes; not time-limited. Up to five devices and five simultaneous users, for academic, speculative or pitching work only. Registration required.
rows.sub: Work made with trial fonts may not be sold, published, distributed or broadcast; it may be shown to a client for evaluation.

rows.t: No student or educational discount is stated. Students are encouraged to use the trial fonts for academic projects, which may be exhibited at formal academic events.
Variable fonts include a matching static family pack, and the shop upgrades a basket to Unlimited Perpetual when that is cheaper. No other discounts are published.

rows.t: Dalton Maag Ltd, registered in England, based in London; founded in 1991 by Swiss typeface designer Bruno Maag. A studio of around forty people.
You may transfer all your rights if you notify Dalton Maag in writing beforehand, the new licensee accepts the whole agreement, you delete all copies, and the entire Licence Pack is transferred.
Governed by the laws of England and Wales. The EULA names no specific court or venue.
